# Provenance

`input.hea` and `input.dat` contain the first 25 seconds of PPG from
`mimic_perform_af_001` in the MIMIC PERform AF dataset. The published WFDB archive is at
<https://zenodo.org/records/15906524>. The record identifies original subject `p000946`.

The source is sampled at 125 Hz. The fixture keeps only the named PPG channel and preserves its
uncalibrated values. The adapter owns the model-specific filtering, resampling, and scaling.

The source archive supplies a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license file.
